players.name: BellyTb1

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 2 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the centre-backs: stay between the ball and your goal, and intercept rather than chase.
Engage the ball carrier: a won tackle is worth ~0.2 rating and even a 12% success rate pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box; most goals against come from unmarked late runs.

weaknesses.detail: 17/25 passes (68%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below ~72% accuracy every extra pass costs rating. Take the simple option until the accuracy comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the shoulder - otherwise recycle or switch play.
If nothing is on, keep the ball: shield, turn back, and let the shape reset.

weaknesses.detail: 25 passes but no key passes - plenty of the ball, little going forward
weaknesses.title: Playing forward
tips: Look forward first: check the striker's run and the space between the lines before the safe sideways pass.
Switch play to the far side when the opponent shifts across - it is the quickest way to create a chance.
Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks; that is where midfield key passes and goals come from.

players.headline: Outstanding midfielder performance (8.6, top 10% for the position) - best at on-ball involvement, goal threat; work on defensive work rate, forcing passes.

players.name: tuxedo_slide

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 54% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 71% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Use one- and two-touch passing in triangles; hold the ball only when you have space to turn.
Default to the simple ground pass to the open, facing teammate; save driven and lobbed passes for clear lanes.
Scan before receiving: know your next pass before the ball arrives so you are not passing under pressure.

weaknesses.detail: Passes attempted: 11 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 15 or less)
weaknesses.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Show for the ball: move into passing lanes and call for it (pass request) instead of standing behind a marker.
Stay within your role's zone so teammates always know where their outlet is.

Track your runner all the way into the box; most goals against come from unmarked late runs.

players.headline: Strong midfielder performance (8.4, top 25% for the position) - best at goal threat, chance creation; work on passing accuracy, on-ball involvement.

weaknesses.detail: Shots: 0 (bottom quarter of forwards is 0 or less)
weaknesses.title: Getting shots off
tips: Play on the last defender's shoulder and time runs as the passer lifts their head.
Ask for the ball early in the half-space where a first-time finish is possible.
Attack the box: make near- and far-post runs on every cross and cutback.
